data.title: US announces new military strikes on Iran
data.description: The US Central Command announced on Tuesday that it began striking Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targets in Iran.

data.title: Russia escalates attacks on Ukraine's capital
data.description: Russian forces have been stepping up attacks on Kyiv. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said new missile and drone strikes have killed 12 people in the capital and other areas. He also said many of the drones have jet engines.

data.title: Shanghai Cooperation Organisation summit closes with show of unity with Iran
data.description: Leaders of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation members have wrapped up their summit with a declaration expressing solidarity with Iran.
